name: mcpfabric
description: Let Claude see and play Minecraft: Java Edition through the mcpfabric mod (Fabric and NeoForge, 1.21.1 to 26.3).
long_description: Install the mcpfabric mod (https://modrinth.com/mod/mcpfabric) and start Minecraft. The extension finds the running game on its own; set the token only if you turned writeDiscoveryFile off in config/mcpfabric.config.json. The mod's enable* flags decide what the AI may do.

token.title: Bridge token (optional)
token.description: Only if the mod does not write ~/.mcpfabric/bridge.json (writeDiscoveryFile: false): the token from config/mcpfabric.config.json.

url.title: Bridge address
url.description: Used together with the token above.

toolsets.title: Tool sets (optional)
toolsets.description: Comma-separated profiles or groups, e.g. play or admin. Empty: all tools.
